verdict.rationale: Convex documents a first-party `npx convex export` command that exports deployment data to a ZIP file, and lists data import/export interoperability as a database feature. The backend is open source and self-hostable with the same code as the cloud service, which gives a credible exit path off the hosted service. missing for 10: documentation of the file formats inside the export ZIP (e.g., JSON/CSV per table), explicit coverage of file storage and other non-table data in the export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full export-and-migrate workflow.
